title: Vesper and the Radiators
author: Jude Winterbourne
blurb: Orsen Halloran, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
